subject: skill/stack/python
claim: This repository requires Python 3.10 or later and configures Ruff with line-length = 100 and target-version = py310. Its retrieval path runs dense and lexical store legs concurrently through a two-worker ThreadPoolExecutor; this is a concrete I/O retrieval implementation, not a repository-wide process-pool policy.
notes: Repo conformance edit: retained the configured interpreter and Ruff rules and the observed retrieval executor. Removed unverified repository-wide requirements for docstrings and ProcessPoolExecutor selection.
